extracted.intended_audience: Researchers, postsecondary institutions, colleges, and partner organizations seeking NSERC funding in Canada (and international collaborators)
extracted.subtask_description: A catalog of NSERC funding programs describing each opportunity's purpose, target applicants/partnerships, and status—used to determine appropriate funding streams and align proposals with program objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alliance Advantage
rubrics_metrics.description: Alliance Advantage grants (formerly Alliance cost-sharing option 1) support research projects conducted in collaboration with partner organizations to address their needs and accelerate the application of results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Open. Date modified: 2026-04-07. Emphasizes collaboration with partner organizations, addressing partner needs, and accelerating application/translation of research results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alliance International
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports partnerships between Canadian and international academic researchers to establish and grow research collaborations of global importance that will generate benefits to Canada.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2026-02-06. Targets establishment and growth of international academic research partnerships with clear benefits to Canada.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alliance International Catalyst Quantum grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Support researchers in Canada to initiate and develop research collaborations with international researchers from the academic sector in the areas of quantum science and quantum technologies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2025-10-31. Focused on early-stage international collaborations in quantum science/technologies (academic sector partners).

rubrics_metrics.name: Alliance International Collaboration Quantum grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Support researchers in Canada to collaborate with international researchers from the academic sector on research projects in the areas of quantum science and quantum technologies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2024-04-24. Targets collaborative research projects in quantum science/technologies with international academic partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alliance Quantum grants call for proposals: Advancing the development and adoption of quantum technologies in Canada
rubrics_metrics.description: Alliance Quantum grants delivered through this call for proposals will support projects that advance the development and adoption of quantum technologies in Canada through partnerships between university researchers and organizations from the private, public or not-for-profit sectors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Open. Date modified: 2026-04-09. Emphasizes partnerships across university and non-academic sectors and translation toward adoption of quantum technologies; projects should generate new knowledge and translate results into tangible benefits for Canada.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alliance Society
rubrics_metrics.description: Alliance Society grants (formerly Alliance cost-sharing option 2) support research projects conducted in collaboration with partner organizations to address challenges at the intersection of natural sciences, engineering and society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Open. Date modified: 2025-10-20. Focus on interdisciplinary challenges linking natural sciences/engineering with societal issues; collaborative with partner organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applied Research and Development grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Support R&D projects led by college researchers in partnership with private sector, public sector or not-for-profit organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Open. Date modified: 2026-03-03. Intended for college-led applied R&D with external partners across sectors; emphasis on practical research and development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applied Research Tools and Instruments grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Strengthen college applied research by supporting the purchase of cutting-edge equipment and instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2025-10-28. Targets capital purchases (tools/instruments) to build college research capacity; supports strengthening applied research infrastructure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arthur B. McDonald Fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: Up to six Arthur B. McDonald Fellowships are awarded annually to recognize early-stage academic researchers in the natural sciences and engineering, and to…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2025-10-29. Fellowship program recognizing early-stage academic researchers in natural sciences and engineering (description truncated on page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Belmont Forum – Towards the ocean we want: biodiversity and ecosystem sustainability for nature and human well-being (CRA Ocean 2)
rubrics_metrics.description: A Belmont Forum Collaborative Research Action to support transdisciplinary research that addresses global environmental challenges related to oceans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Open. Date modified: 2025-08-29. Transdisciplinary emphasis; addresses global ocean-related environmental challenges and human well-being.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Master’s program
rubrics_metrics.description: The objective of the Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Master’s (CGRS M) program is to help develop research skills and assist in the training of highly qualified personnel by supporting students who demonstrate potential to contribute to Canadian research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2025-08-28. Targets master's students; supports research training and development of research skills in individuals with potential to contribute to Canadian research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Doctoral program
rubrics_metrics.description: The objective of the Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Doctoral (CGRS D) program is to recognize and support the next generation of outstanding innovators, knowledge workers, creative thinkers and researchers. By providing support for a high-quality research training experience to awardees, the program strives to foster impacts within and beyond the research environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2025-07-10. Targets doctoral students; emphasizes outstanding potential, high-quality research training, and broader impacts beyond academia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canada Postdoctoral Research Award program
rubrics_metrics.description: The objective of the Canada Postdoctoral Research Award (CPRA) program is to recognize and support the next generation of outstanding innovators, knowledge workers, creative thinkers and researchers at a pivotal time in their careers. The program provides funding and flexibility, empowering Canadian and international leaders in innovation and scholarship of tomorrow to develop the skills to build world-class research and drive Canadian prosperity and competitiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2025-07-18. Targets postdoctoral researchers (Canadian and international); emphasizes career development, skills for world-class research, and contributions to Canadian prosperity and competitiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canada Research Training Awards Suite – Research Travel Supplements
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional funding for active master’s and doctoral award holders to offset the costs of research travel within or outside Canada.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Open. Date modified: 2026-04-14. Supplements existing graduate awards to support research travel expenses; intended for active award holders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Canadian Forest Sector Workforce Diversity supplement
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplement to support initiatives related to workforce diversity in the Canadian forest sector.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Open. Date modified: 2025-12-19. Aims to increase diversity within a sector-specific workforce (forest sector); likely a targeted supplement to other awards or projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chairs for Women in Science and Engineering program
rubrics_metrics.description: The Chairs for Women in Science and Engineering (CWSE) program is regional—with one Chair for each of the Atlantic, Quebec, Ontario, Prairie and British Columbia regions. The goal of this program is to increase the participation of women in science and engineering and to provide role models for women considering careers in these fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2023-01-18. Regional chairs program aimed at increasing participation of women in science and engineering and providing role models; one chair per region.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative Research and Training Experience program
rubrics_metrics.description: Participate as a trainee in a collaborative and interdisciplinary research environment. Acquire in-demand professional skills to complement research skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2026-02-03. Focus on traineeship experiences in collaborative, interdisciplinary settings and acquiring professional skills alongside research training.

rubrics_metrics.name: College and Community Social Innovation Fund grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Fosters community innovation by connecting the talent, facilities and capabilities of Canada’s colleges with the research needs of community organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2025-10-28. Emphasizes college–community partnerships to address community research needs and social innovation.

rubrics_metrics.name: G7 Countries Alliance International Catalyst Quantum grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Support researchers in Canada to initiate and develop research collaborations with international researchers from the academic sector in G7 member countries in the areas of quantum science and quantum technologies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2025-10-30. Similar to Alliance International Catalyst Quantum but specifically targeting collaborations with academic researchers in G7 countries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dimensions Canada grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Dimensions Canada grants are a new funding opportunity designed to help postsecondary institutions strengthen the competencies that they need to increase equity, diversity and inclusion. These grants also seek to foster transformational change in the Canadian research community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: Closed. Date modified: 2025-12-03. Targets institutional capacity-building around equity, diversity, and inclusion (EDI) and transformational change across the research community.
